date.as_written: śrīmatanyaṃpāla (!)samvat bhuvanākāśabhairavaṃ | jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇacaturthe tu saṃpūrṇṇaṃ ravivāsare

notes: The phrase 'śrīmatanyaṃpāla (!)samvat' is almost certainly a scribal error or misreading of 'śrīmannepālasaṃvat'. The chronogram bhuvanākāśabhairava represents 803 (bhuvana = 3, ākāśa = 0, bhairava = 8). Two scribes divided the copying: Tasisiṃha wrote one half and Bhavānīśaṅkara the other (likhārddhaṃ tasisiṃhena [ta]darddhaṃ bhavāniśaṃkar[eṇa]).
